status_note: WU1 template only. Every null field below is REQUIRED_HUMAN_INPUT before WU2's preflight may return anything but zero launch. This file is not itself an authority grant; it is the shape a grant-bound run manifest must have, modeled on the existing, ratified bounded_review_numeric_limits shape in docs/bounded_technical_review.md Sec.4 / 03_BINDING/DEVELOPMENT_BINDING_POLICY.json -- a closed, code-pinned, caller-non-widenable field set, never silently extended at runtime.

project_binding.note: A fresh, disposable test-only binding per the NRC1-trial pattern already proven in this repo (never SHUKOU's production Authority, never a publicly known fixture key).

dots_participant.note: Per DOTS_CONNECTIVITY_ASSESSMENT.md Sec.4: memory cannot be reset per-task; only whole-dot deletion plausibly resets it. This field must record TRUE/FALSE per run -- a FALSE here forces that run's comparative_effect to BLOCKED_CONTAMINATION, never silently treated as isolated.

connected_executors.note: Must be a current executor_providers member (CLAUDE_CODE or GITHUB_COPILOT per 03_BINDING/DEVELOPMENT_BINDING_POLICY.json). Must NOT be CODEX (BOUNDED_TECHNICAL_REVIEWER only, must_not IMPLEMENTATION/CODE_AUTHORSHIP). See DOTS_CONNECTIVITY_ASSESSMENT.md Sec.3 for the unresolved Reading A/B decision this field depends on.

resource_ceilings.note: money_ceiling_jpy defaults to 0 (zero launch) until explicitly ratified non-zero. Per DOTS_CONNECTIVITY_ASSESSMENT.md Sec.5, no confirmed hard platform-level spend stop exists for dots-originated usage; money_ceiling_enforcement must name the actual external control (human alert-monitoring, prepaid instrument, etc.) before this ceiling may be treated as self-enforcing.

stop_control.note: Per DOTS_CONNECTIVITY_ASSESSMENT.md Sec.2, dots pause confirms only the main task; delegated/scheduled work needs separate, additional stop actions -- stop_control_ref must name ALL controls actually exercised for this run, not just 'pause'.
